episodes.title: Creator
episodes.summary: After an unspeakable tragedy happens to the CEO of CompWare, a mysterious consultant arrives to take over.

episodes.title: Mama
episodes.summary: In search of answers about her son's death, Mama Sang pays a visit to CompWare. Elaine questions Regus' motives, while Craig makes unexpected headway on a new game.

episodes.title: Friday
episodes.summary: Regus invites himself out with Craig, which quickly escalates and gets out of control. Meanwhile, preparing for a date, Elaine stumbles upon a key to the records room.

episodes.title: Sang
episodes.summary: We flashback to Sang-woo meeting Regus Patoff and their binding contract. In the present, Craig's still rattled by his night out with the boss, while Elaine makes strides to keep CompWare afloat.

episodes.title: Sick
episodes.summary: Determined to uncover the enigmatic Frank Florez, Craig makes a trip to Pomona. At the office, chaos ensues when Regus Patoff announces a managerial suite is up for grabs.

episodes.title: Glass
episodes.summary: As CompWare's latest game nears launch, Elaine fears the worst of its effect on consumers. Despite Craig's efforts at church, Patti feels Regus Patoff's pull, drawing her from her fiancé.

episodes.title: Elephant
episodes.summary: Days later, Patti's yet to return home, causing Craig to spiral. Chained to an impossible task, Elaine finds herself calling upon an ex for help.

episodes.title: Hammer
episodes.summary: Mr. Sang's Jungle Odyssey hits the market with notable numbers. Elaine continues to challenge her moral compass, Craig confronts what's been haunting him all season, and Regus eyes his next enterprise.
